Kenneth and Liam launch a Blow & Go makeover competition, which attracts some very unlikely entrants

events.description: Truths, lies and confessions emerge as time starts to run out for the five people trapped underground. Meanwhile, back above ground, Karen desperately tries to work out where the missing five have gone - and as the clock ticks down, the residents of Chatsworth must decide whether to involve the authorities in the search

event.name: Minder
event.description: Arthur buys a large consignment of wine, supposedly brewed by monks. Before he can collect his order it is impounded, but he sneaks into a warehouse and retrieves it anyway. However, a disastrous tasting session at the Winchester reveals the product to be 'corked' and undrinkable and when he and Ray return it in the hope of a later refund they get locked in. George Cole and Gary Webster star

event.name: Benidorm
event.description: Mateo reveals his home life is a disaster - his mother-in-law Dolores is threatening to kill him - so Lesley urges the barman to move out and start a new life. But will it be that easy? Clive, Tiger and Terri come up with a plan to retrieve Clive's 5,000 euros from dodgy property developer Monty, while Psychic Sue drops by Blow & Go with a message for Liam. Jacqueline and Glynn look forward to a reunion with their real partners, but when Riannon arrives, there's no sign of Donald. Guest starring Ruth Madoc (Hi-de-Hi!)

event.name: Shameless
event.description: Truths, lies and confessions emerge as time starts to run out for the five people trapped underground. Jamie panics that Karen will learn the truth about Gloria, Frank has a sobering revelation about what his life has become, while Ruby and Aidan grow increasingly angry with how the others perceive them. Meanwhile, back above ground, Karen desperately tries to work out where the missing five have gone - and as the clock ticks down, the residents of Chatsworth must decide whether to involve the authorities in the search
